body:
Directors can publish organisation prices through the existing pricing boundary. Existing installations receive the approved prices.publish.organisation grant through an additive migration. Other permission holders and staff-account authority remain unchanged; BIL36 printing and BIL37 doctor read access remain intact.

Synthetic reference-only and rollback fixtures explicitly remove publish authority while preserving denial and rollback assertions. Positive tests cover ordinary Director pricing, catalogue import, consultation tariffs and linked medicine setup. Migration tests cover repeatability, missing roles and unchanged unrelated grants. The migration remains byte-identical to the approved artifact; down() intentionally preserves grants.

The final candidate contains main 9764037af1bfcb24ebad3102a124ff3f6cd7acd2. All eleven scoped blobs are identical to the previously reviewed publication eff0f716; independent source and refresh review cleared c7334e3e0c87272d0777b49936e4c7c33d2e13ca. The last main integration adds only the released TriageDoctorViewTest fixture correction outside this PR's scope.

Validation: 73 focused PostgreSQL Feature tests / 1,556 assertions passed after the SUG1b main integration, including staff-authority boundaries and BIL36/BIL37 integration. Scoped Pint, PHPStan (0 errors) and diff checks passed; no frontend source changed. The final fixture-only integration preserves every tested BIL38 blob. Fresh exact-head CI and then-current-main ancestry remain required before merge. No production migration, deployment or real-data operation occurred.
